title: Microsoft Dataverse: richer record labels for Copilot /mention in Microsoft 365 apps
summary: The record facts, environment control and licensing statements are supported. However, the briefing says Microsoft's page does not identify Copilot actions, although that page gives an email-drafting and sending procedure. The general statement about Dataverse security roles also needs its supporting reference added.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The /mention page does not list which Copilot actions are possible.
claims.quote: In Copilot, enter a prompt to create a new email with instructions to include business data, with **/account**. ... Copilot provides a draft email with business data. ... Ask Copilot to send the email.
claims.fix: Replace 'It does not list which actions, so confirm what Copilot can do with a referenced record before you rely on it.' with 'The page shows Copilot drafting an email with business data and a request to send it; confirm what Copilot can do with a referenced record before you rely on it.' Keep the existing citation to https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The /mention documentation does not describe the authorisation mechanism beyond access requirements.
claims.quote: Searched: authorisation and access passages in the fully opened /admin/link-records-outlook-web. It specifies user access and recipient environment, app, record and security-role access; it gives no further implementation of the authorisation mechanism.

claims.where: Governance controls: final paragraph
claims.claim: Access to the underlying Dataverse records follows Dataverse security roles.
claims.quote: A combination of access levels and permissions in a security role determines which apps and data users can view and how they can interact with those apps and data.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/database-security to sources, titled 'Role-based security roles for Dataverse', for the general statement about users' access through Dataverse security roles.
